title: Ridgeline Pro Credit and ProBuild Rewards Overtime Percentage on Ridgeline Tool Rental
content:
The percentage of the daily rate at which each engine overtime hour on metered Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment is priced depends on the accounts the renter holds at Ridgeline.

**Clause.** The overtime percentage depends on the renter's accounts: when the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account is active and the renter holds an active Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership at the ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum or ProBuild Platinum Elite tier, the overtime percentage is 9 percent of the daily rate per hour; when the Pro Credit account is active and the renter holds no active ProBuild membership at one of those tiers, it is 11 percent; when the renter holds no active Pro Credit account, it is the class's overtime percentage.

The overtime hourly price is the agreement's daily rate multiplied by the overtime percentage so decided.

## Records read

- The status on the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account record.
- The status and the tier on the renter's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership record.

## Percentage table

| Ridgeline Pro Credit account | ProBuild membership | Overtime percentage of the daily rate per hour |
|---|---|---|
| active | active at Gold, Platinum or Platinum Elite | 9 |
| active | active at Member, Bronze or Silver | 11 |
| active | suspended, closed, pending verification, or none | 11 |
| not active, or none | any | the class's overtime percentage |

## Hypothetical hourly prices on a daily rate of 400.00

| Accounts | Percentage | Hourly price |
|---|---|---|
| Pro Credit active, ProBuild Platinum active | 9 | 36.00 |
| Pro Credit active, ProBuild Silver active | 11 | 44.00 |
| Pro Credit on hold, ProBuild Gold active | the class's | class figure applied to 400.00 |
